title: Valid Transaction Type Codes
applicability: Directly applicable to Segment 100 Element 78 Prompt Code transaction-type position.

classificationEvidence.scope: One-character source code recognition and classification only; no Prompt Code/card-type combination or special-flow certification.

businessRequirements.title: Segment 100 Element 78 Prompt Code combines one valid Appendix G Transaction Type code with one valid Appendix E Card Type code.
businessRequirements.coverageNote: Code catalog and standard-financial type recognition are covered separately. Full Prompt Code composition, especially code 9's stated Card Type restriction (00 and 81-97), remains unverified.

businessRequirements.title: Standard financial Segment 100 requests support the 13 source-defined financial Transaction Type codes.
Transaction Type 9 denotes a special transaction and shall not be treated as a standard financial Segment 100 request.
Lifecycle transaction types use the source-defined relationships for completion, cancellation, reversal, void, and timeout recovery.
Authorization/completion and sale/reversal lifecycle behavior shall preserve the applicable MasterCard preauthorization or final-authorization context when relevant.

testCases.positive: All 13 standard financial codes recognized; all 23 Appendix G codes classified in the linked independent package
reviewRequired: Code 9 Card Type restriction and complete Prompt Code combinations

testDataStatus: 13 standard financial types have independent oracle tests; linked Appendix G classification package has 23 positive and 7 unknown/malformed independent TD chains. Lifecycle tests remain separate. The 9/Card Type Prompt Code constraint and full combination behavior are not certified.
remaining: Validate AI-generated Prompt Codes across all 13 financial types and applicable card types.
Resolve code 9 Card Type representation and combination semantics against Appendix E/Element 78.
Resolve MasterCard-specific interpretation through source/client review.
